messages.subject: Cannot set breakpoints
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I'm not able to set a breakpoint; all possibilities are greyed-out, e.g.
right clicking the line number margin, from the Run menu, and Shift+Ctrl+B.
 This applies to locations within a local method and within the workspace.
 Everything else works fine (i.e. running R, sending commands, viewing
objects in the browser, etc.), and I'm running a debug configuration with
RJ and Eclipse Integrations set with methods loaded through "Run Function
Definition" and/or "Run Entire Command".
More info: my setup is Eclipse Platform 4.2.1, StateET 3.3.0, RJ Library
Eclipse Client 1.2.1, RJ Java Core 1.1.3 on an Ubuntu 12.10 installation
with R 2.15.1.

Is there a way to tell if the console is actually running in debug mode?
Otherwise, what should I try/look at?


Thanks,

Brandon

messages.subject: "Error: no packages were specified" in making R Package
messages.subject_clean: "Error: no packages were specified" in making R Package
messages.body_plain:
Hello dear members

I have a problem in making a R Package. Please help me.

I try to make R package on eclipse with StatET.

1. I select a new project "R Package" on eclipse
2. I made a R example function "myFunc" and ran it on RTerm on eclipse.
3. I ran "packages.skeleton(myFunc)" and generated some folder and
files for my R package.
4. I rewrite some files (DESCRIPTION and  *.Rd etc.)
5. I made sure that terminal could deal with normally R CMD Check
command.( = done some checks)
6.  [my problem] I set a R external tool as bellow.
(title) Name: "R CMD check"
Command: "Add-on packages: check" is  "CMD Check"
Option/Arguments: Empty
Package directory and archive: ${resource_loc}
Working directory: ${resource_loc}

7. I ran the R external command after selecting "myFunc" on project
explorer. I got message "Error: no packages were specified" on console
of eclipse.

What problem to run R CMD?

My env.
OS: Mac X 10.8.4 ( I tried on Windows7 too, I got no message on RTerm)
R: v2.15.3 i386
Eclipse v4.2
StatET v3.3.0

messages.subject: problem sending commands to R console from the editor
messages.subject_clean: problem sending commands to R console from the editor
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I've been running into some strange problems recently in StatET.  I'm
running Eclipse 3.8.2, StatET 3.3.0b201306021645E38sw, R 2.15.2 64-bit on
Win7 Pro 64-bit.


When I use "Run entire command in R and go to next command (Ctrl+R
Ctrl+3)", it somehow remembers the previous version of the file and send
that, instead of what I've already changed, even after I save the changes.
Nothing short of exiting and re-starting statET would resolve this.

The second problem I run into, sometimes, with pressing the same button
mentioned above is that it submits the line below where I have the cursor,
not the line where the cursor is.

The strange thing is it doesn't always happens, but has been happening more
often recently (almost every session ends up like this), which makes it
nearly unusable.  I'd really appreciate any help!

Best,
Andy

-- 
Andy Liaw

Arnaud

here an error message tell me there might be a firewall problem or

administrators of the new server ? to gain access to the port TCP 1099

registry to listen another port and statET to connect to it ?

Best regards,

Arnaud
